Oh, really? I am so happy to hear that! By the way, when will we meet?

messages.content: Hello, I'm Yang. I'm buying a gift for my son. It's his birthday this weekend.
Hi Yang! Oh, really? That's so nice. Well, what kind of gift does he like?
He likes video games. But the games are too expensive here. I don't have much money.
I see. Oh, I understand. By the way, do you want something cheaper or higher quality?
I want high quality. But it must be under 500 yuan. Can you help me?
Of course! Well, we have some good games here. Actually, this one is very popular and not too dear.
What is the name? Is it from a big company?
Yes, it's from Tencent. It's called Honor of Kings. Oh, you know, many kids play it.
Oh, I've heard of it. How much is it now?
It's only 320 yuan. That's much cheaper than the others. You'll save some money.
That's perfect. I can buy it today. Thank you for your help.
You're welcome! Well, I'll wrap it for you right now. Here's your gift box.
